title: Selling Plans — Seller Tenure Multiplier on Chargeback Administration Fees
content:
Long-standing sellers pay less administration fee on a **Selling Plans** chargeback credit. Tenure is counted from the verification date on the seller's selling plan record.

**Rule.** The chargeback administration fee is also multiplied by the long-tenure chargeback multiplier when the selling plan was verified at least the long tenure months before the decision date, by the mid-tenure chargeback multiplier when it was verified at least the mid tenure months but fewer than the long tenure months before, and by one otherwise, the tenure being counted in whole months.

The multiplier applies to the administration fee as worked out from the credit before the fee and its rate; the product is then rounded to the nearest cent, and only the rounded amount is compared with the cap.

| Whole months from verification to the decision date | Multiplier on the administration fee |
|---|---|
| 36 or more (the long tenure months) | 0.5 (long-tenure chargeback multiplier) |
| 24 or more but fewer than 36 (the mid tenure months up to the long) | 0.75 (mid-tenure chargeback multiplier) |
| Fewer than 24 | One |

## Hypothetical dates (plan verified on 15 June 2022)

- Decided on 15 June 2025: 36 whole months → 0.5.
- Decided on 14 June 2025: 35 whole months → 0.75.
- Decided on 14 June 2024: 23 whole months → one.

**Applying it (hypothetical).** An administration fee worked out at USD 4.00 before this multiplier becomes USD 2.00 at 0.5 and USD 3.00 at 0.75, each then compared with the cap.
